items.what_happened: ## What's changed - Added `oidc.user_id_claim` to the Claude apps gateway, to identify people by an id_token claim other than `sub`, such as Microsoft Entra ID's `oid` - Added click to send: in fullscreen, clicking the "to send now" hint under a queued message sends it right away, as its key does - Fixed managed settings and organization policy not being fetched for the rest of the session after signing in from the V
